newsitem.title: GERMANY: Colonia upbeat on UAP /Axa merger.
newsitem.headline: Colonia upbeat on UAP /Axa merger.

text.p: Colonia AG, the German unit of Union Assurances de Paris (UAP), on Tuesday said it welcomed its French parent's unexpected revelation of plans to merge with Axa.
UAP and Axa revealed their plans to merge earlier on Tuesday and analysts said Colonia would be a key aspect in the deal, giving Axa access to the German market.

"This will make us part of a real global player," Colonia spokesman Ulrich Bockrath told Reuters, adding that the alliance would mean the French group could overtake Germany's Allianz AG Holding in Europe.
The move would not mean many changes for Colonia in Germany, where Axa currently has only one small direct insurance unit, Bockrath said.
UAP took control of Colonia three years ago and currently owns around 68 percent of the German group.
